item.title: Economic Survey 2026 flags surge in ultra-processed food consumption, recommends higher GST
item.description: The Economic Survey 2026 urges moving ultra-processed foods to the highest GST slab and adding surcharges on high sugar, salt, and fat products. It recommends replacing health star ratings with warning labels to combat rising obesity linked to UPF consumption.

item.description: The Economic Survey 2026 warns that unconditional cash transfers to women could add Rs 1.7 lakh crore to state deficits, urging a shift to conditional schemes tied to health and education.
